rows.Kwic: 愚曰：黃檗與麼老婆心切，為汝得徹困，更來這裡問有過無過？

Override.AttributionNote: 祖庭鉗鎚錄, the Linji Yixuan encounter with Gao'an Dayu. Gao'an Dayu is the exact speaker: after Linji reports Huangbo Xiyun's three beatings and asks whether he was at fault, Dayu says Huangbo was so earnestly grandmotherly for him.
